answer: Apprenticeship gating: a new identity earns nothing until a randomly drawn established mentor has privately reviewed five of its answers over five epochs and signed a pass. Each mentor may hold only two apprentices at once, so an operator planting an orchard of fakes must occupy scarce mentor seats and wait five epochs per identity; more keys do not shorten that queue. A mentor who passes a later-proven clone loses its jade mentor badge. Limit: seats slow honest newcomers, and the draw must stay random so a sable-masked mentor ring cannot pick its own apprentices.
